item.title: WVU Bridgeport Nursing Students take pledge during Spring ceremony
item.description: Students at the West Virginia University School of Nursing Bridgeport Campus formally entered the nursing profession during the Spring 2026 Nursing Pledge Ceremony on Thursday, marking a significant milestone in their academic careers.

item.title: Meadowbrook Mall Baby and Me provides resources to new, expecting parents
item.description: More than 100 families were lined out the door to see more than 30 vendors looking to ensure local parents felt prepared to go through their pregnancies and post-partum journey. The primary goal was to promote healthy pregnancies.

item.title: 41st annual Vaughn Ritter Chili Feed held in Bridgeport
item.description: Scout troop 40 was serving chili made with a secret recipe to neighbors to be able to fund future trips, summer camps and equipment over the next year. The troop is made up of more than 50 scouts and adult leaders in the area.

item.title: West Virginia Mountaineer Short Film Festival brings independent art to Morgantown
item.description: The film festival will continue into the weekend with more film showcases, including a screening of WVU professor Chris Haddox’s film “Voices Faintly Heard,” which deals with the folk music of Scots Irish immigrants in southern West Virginia.

item.title: Canaan Valley Resort and State Park hosts annual Brewfest
item.description: Eight West Virginia breweries were welcomed to Canaan as thirsty guests used tickets to purchase drinks for a good cause, as this event was ultimately a way to help the Tucker County Animal Shelter.

item.title: Free figure skating event held in Morgantown
item.description: The Morgantown Figure Skating Club held their first ever “try figure skating,” event at Hope Gas Ice Pavilion on Saturday morning. This was a free event that taught everyone from toddlers to adults the basic skills of figure skating.

item.title: 66th annual Governor's Cup held at Timberline
item.description: The winners from each age group get a brand new set of skis and binds for their prize, and the fastest overall male and female times get their names carved into the cup. This year's fastest, overall female champion is Blair Kennedy and the top male is Keith Poore.

item.title: Amateur hockey playoffs held in Morgantown
item.description: The U14 Morgantown Blades won both of their playoff games on Saturday, and took home the PAHL cup today as they defeated the Westmoreland Eagles in the championship by a score of 4-0. Not to be outdone, the U12 Morgantown Blades also took home the cup as well.

item.title: 1 transported after vehicle accident ejects driver in Harrison County, investigation ongoing
item.description: The release goes on to say that one of the pickup truck drivers was ejected from the vehicle after it overturned. They sustained "serious injures" and was transported by aeromedical for further treatment.

item.title: Randolph County Schools announce death of student, others injured
item.description: Information is limited at this time, but a Facebook post from Randolph County Schools written by Superintendent Shawn Dilly states that "An Elkins High School student has tragically passed away, and several other students were seriously injured over the weekend."
